name: agent-flight-recorder
description: Local-first black box recorder for LLM agents

scripts.dev:ui: wait-on http://localhost:3001/api/health && cd ui && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../ui && npm run build
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../sdks/typescript && npm test && cd ../python && python3 -m pytest tests/test_sdk.py
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../ui && npm install && cd ../sdks/typescript && npm install
